bio: Indulge in a Classic Afternoon Tea by the Sea at The Hotel Riviera in Sidmouth, Devon.  In this busy world, Afternoon Tea is the antidote. Slow down and appreciate a moment, together. A glass of bubbly for the special occasion. A warming pot of the finest loose leaf after a blustery sea walk.  The experience is a quintessential slice of traidion - Homemade scones, fresh strawberries, confiture and Devon cream are the order of the day. Catch up and chit-chat. Gaze seaward to the horizon as your mind drifts. Let the figures fall from the clock.  From Victorian times, to its heyday in the opulence and romance of the Regency era, Afternoon Tea has been available at The Riviera, throughout our long history of revered 4 star service. Served on fine China in the cosy sea view lounge or terrace in the warmer months, with crisp white tablecloths and napkins; choose from a range of indulgent Afternoon Teas fit for an iconic Afternoon Tea by the Sea experience. The Afternoon Tea selections include a classic Devon Afternoon Tea, Traditional Afternoon Tea and Strawberry Cream Tea menus. Add Smoked Scotch Salmon sandwiches, delicate finger sandwiches or toasted crumpets dripping with butter to balance the sweet, with a carefully selected dessert wine, sparkling Prosecco or Champagne for a special occasion.  Devon Cream Tea is priced at £12.95 Per Person or £19.95 For Two Traditional Afternoon Tea is priced at £26.95 Per Person or £49.95 For Two Strawberry Cream Tea is priced at £16.50 Per Person or £24.95 For Two  Please note that Hotel Riviera require full pre-payment to secure your Afternoon Tea booking. A member of staff will contact you after you have made your booking to arrange payment.
